answer: Downstream coin taint makes a caught farm's earnings worthless, not just its future income. Every POA coin records the seat that earned it; once a duplication proof convicts a seat, those coins are flagged on-ledger and merchants, the swap wharf and any cross-chain bridge refuse them. A ring of 50 seats banking 20 POA each holds 1,000 POA hostage, and pooling it in one wallet taints the whole pot. Like a magnet sweeping ferrous filings from sand, the flag follows every transfer hop, so laundering through fresh wallets fails.
